avis.texte: BACKGROUND: I do not have sensitive skin, never used a retinol product before. Started the product twice a day and by day 3 I got a NASTY burn as shown in the images below with swelling in both of my eyes that got CONSIDERABLY worse. I stopped using the product and everything got better. The seller, upon seeing by negative review (despite saying I'd try it again later once my symptoms went down), in good faith offered to give me a refund. I did not accept the refund because it didn't feel right to try to use the product again AND take their money. I decided before I did that, I would give it one more try. RESEARCH: So, during the heck-ish evening where I constantly put aloe on my face due to the terrible burning sensation, I realized--from watching some dermatology videos--that YOU CANNOT GO 0-100 WITH RETINOL CREMES! I have seen some social media influencer videos sprinkled in there, where the horrendous burning is described as "normal" and "natural"... it is not. You shouldn't be feeling like that: peeling off whole layers of skin and lighting your face up like a Christmas tree. You have to start slow. THE PRODUCT: The bottle says morning and night in the instructions, I believe it says that for someone who is already using retinol cremes. If you are NOT already using it, do not follow these instructions. It is probably best to consult a dermatologist. avis.titre: Turns Out Good Skin Doesn't Care That I'm a Guy
avis.texte: I'm a guy, and I'll admit I wasn't exactly excited about adding a face cream to my routine. I figured I'd try it once and forget about it. Instead, it's become part of my daily routine. The cream absorbs quickly, isn't greasy, and leaves my skin feeling hydrated, smooth, and refreshed. After a few weeks, my skin looked healthier, and even a couple of people asked if I had changed something. I wasn't expecting compliments from a moisturizer, but I'll take them. The combination of retinol, collagen, and hyaluronic acid makes my face feel great without any heavy or oily residue. It works just as well during the day as it does before bed. Five stars. My skin is happier, I still haven't started calling it a "beauty routine," and I've accepted that good skincare doesn't make you less manly. It just makes you look like you sleep eight hours a night.

avis.texte: I’ve really been enjoying this face cream. The texture is rich and creamy without feeling heavy or greasy, and it glides on smoothly. I’ve only been using it for a short time, so it’s too early to speak on long-term results, but so far I’m happy with how it feels and how hydrated my skin looks. A great moisturizer if you’re looking for something that leaves your skin feeling smooth and nourished.

It does tell you what it has it it such as Collagen, retinol and hyaluronic acid, but it doesn't tell you the percentage of anything especially retinol. So I really don't know how strong it is. It is overpriced for what it is. It's not a scammy item, but it's not an anti-aging skin cream at all. And if you're sensitive such as acne prone, with the amount of oil that's in there, such as coconut oil being high on the ingredient list, you might get some irritation. So with that, I returned it. avis.titre: Smell Like a Man, Age Like a Legend
avis.texte: Alright, fellas — I was skeptical. The words retinol, collagen, and hyaluronic acid sound like ingredients in a science experiment or something my wife orders in a $14 smoothie. But hear me out… this stuff WORKS. First off, from a guy’s perspective: it does not smell girly, floral, or like I just walked out of a candle store. No weird perfume vibes. It has a clean, subtle scent that basically says, “I take care of my skin but I also know how to change a tire.” The texture is great — not greasy, not shiny, not sticky. It absorbs fast and doesn’t leave you looking like you dipped your face in motor oil. I use it morning and night, and my skin legitimately looks smoother and more awake. Even the neck area (which I’ve apparently been neglecting my entire life) feels firmer. After a few weeks, I noticed: • Skin feels hydrated all day • Fine lines looking less noticeable • Zero breakouts • No irritation It’s basically low-maintenance skincare for high-maintenance results. If you’re a guy who wants to look younger but doesn’t want to smell like a bouquet of roses while doing it, this is your move. Five stars. My face is thriving.

avis.titre: Not enough retinol to make a difference!
avis.texte: If you're interested in just a moisturizer and a very basic repair, this is a great lotion, but for the price, you could just get something else that's going to be a moisturizer. It does not have enough retinol to do anything. Anything less than 1% is pretty much useless, and the hyaluronic acid you can get for much cheaper. So I would recommend with that caveat, but I probably will purchase another brand next time. This is basically just a moisturizer, and most everything today has hyaluronic acid in it, it's the retinol that I was interested in the most. It is a light milky white lotion, and there is no skin irritation. It does make your face soft, I'll give it that, but so does anything else pretty much on the market today. For a starter treatment for younger people, sure no problem. But I'm over 40, and we need way more retinol to see a drastic change in the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles.

I have been skin cycling for a few months now and it has been working wonders on my skin. I am someone who wants reliable products to keep my skincare collection at the minimum with successful results. To be frank, I was both intrigued and concerned about incorporating this product into my routine because on one hand it can eliminate a few products and have everything all in one. On the other hand, I didn’t know if having certain ingredients together would counteract the working process to receive results of both Collagen, Retinol, and Hyaluronic Acid. The only way to be certain was to test it. Within a skin cycling routine, you have a night designated to retinol followed by a hydrating moisturizer. I incorporated this product into this step of my cycling routine for the past 2 weeks and here is what I have discovered: - the ingredients did not counteract against each other, they actually complemented each other to have a gentle formula to act as a hydrating retinol - it helped clear some of the​ fine lines on my forehead - it works well with my combination skin type - I have very sensitive areas around my face; however, it did not leave me having any allergic reactions I would definitely recommend this product to any beginners wanting to incorporate Retinol into their skincare routine because it’s gentle enough to gain the same results without completely stripping the skin of its moisture.

I initially thought I was getting my money’s worth when I purchased this face cream, it seemed like a pretty generous amount for the price. That is, until product stopped coming out from the pump. I thought, okay whatever, I’ll just unscrew the top and get it with my fingers. That’s when I realized that not only is the pump setup stupidly ineffective, as it doesn’t actually reach the majority of the product (it only gets the product directly in the middle, all of the cream on the outside perimeter you’ll either have to get with your hands or move into the center). But the container only has like 1/3 of its volume’s worth of product. The other 2/3 of the container is just empty space. I can’t speak on the effectiveness of the cream itself, I honestly didn’t see any changes in my skin after 3-4 months of use. It was moisturizing enough. If anything, there were times I felt more prone to breakouts. But I would not recommend this product just simply on how deceptive the container is, making you feel like you’re getting a lot more product than you really are.
